notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Greetings adventurers!

We’ve released a small but important patch for the Leif’s Adventure demo! This update improves the overall experience, making it a better reflection of the full game.

One of the key enhancements is the camera system, which is now more responsive, ensuring better visibility during gameplay. This change makes platforming and combat feel more fluid, bringing the demo closer to experience of the main game.

[previewyoutube=n8bQpkxYdBc;full][/previewyoutube]
If you haven’t tried the demo yet, now is the perfect time to jump in and see the improvements for yourself!  Thanks for all your support and we’d love to hear your feedback.

Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.notes:
Greetings adventurers!

We've released a new update to enhance your journey through Leif's Adventure: Netherworld Hero. Check out the details below:

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list][*] Resolved an issue when buying skills at the dojo. If you're affected, talk to the dojo owner again about the skill you purchased.
[*] Fixed camera escape problems to improve visual consistency.
[*] Prevented the spider boss from being triggered outside its battle room.
[*] Corrected missing wall and ceiling colliders.
[*] Fixed geometry in the Crimson Quarry to allow the boulder to be properly blocked when rolling it to the right wall.
[*] Addressed an edge hang issue that disrupted smooth navigation.
[*] Corrected misaligned Crimson Quarry map, adding missing portal and save point symbols.
[*] Fixed journal quest entries not being marked complete after finishing them.
[*] Resolved typos across the game text.
[*] Fixed wrong shopping icons and input symbol positioning on PS5.
[*] Fixed a blocker when exiting the broken cave through the entrance, ensuring level progression.
[*] Fixed some missing sound effects.[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list][*] Enhanced camera behavior for a smoother and more immersive gaming experience.
[*] Enlarged the exit from the rotating wheel in Tigros Kingdom for easier navigation.
[*] Added an autosave just after the Ice Golem Mini-Boss to safeguard your progress.[/list]
[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list][*] Removed weapon interaction with shrine backgrounds to prevent unnecessary weapon damage.
[*] Fixed hammer upgrade achievements. If you've already upgraded your hammer, simply revisit the corresponding statues to unlock the achievement.
[*] Changed some sound effects from 3D to 2D for a better experience.[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! If you encounter any issues, don’t hesitate to let us know. Happy adventuring!

notes.title: New demo available now!

Dear Gamer,

We’ve just released a major update to the Leif’s Adventure demo, bringing it up to speed with the latest state of the game! This version introduces new content and mechanics, so even if you’ve played the demo before, you’ll find plenty of fresh experiences waiting for you.

notes.title: Leif's Adventure's Weapon System
notes.notes:
There are over 50 unique weapons in Leif’s Adventure: axes, swords, battle spears, hammers and clubs. There’s even a hammer with a pig mounted on top of it.  Each weapon brings a unique advantage and some are infused with elemental power. There’s a lot to consider when picking a weapon to defeat the evils in the Netherworld. [b]Let’s dive in! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/71f080928665d6d9820183738725ea1b3a712353.png[/img]

[b]Damage System[/b]

When equipping Leif with a weapon you should consider three aspects: damage value, durability and the type of damage the weapon deals. Some weapons deal a ton of damage, but are slow, or break after a short while. Balance the pros and cons of each weapon to suit your playstyle. 

Some weapons have "hidden" features. There are weapons that heal you with a certain probability. Some weapons create a projectile each time you complete a combo. Or even a weapon that is cursed, and damages you when you use, it until you have completed a certain quest. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/87d40088b3d34a91614fd0ad2d225514c552a4e2.gif[/img]

[b]The power of the elements[/b]

The elemental damage system in Leif’s Adventure is based on the Rock, Paper, Scissors principle. The three elements are fire, ice and electricity. Fire is effective against ice, ice works best against electricity and electricity beats fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/141d63002e2e965f19cd27228120c3b5281c0640.png[/img]

Always consider the elemental effect a weapon can have on your enemy. Elemental effects can make your weapon extremely effective against certain types of enemies, but be less effective against others. Sometimes elemental effects are necessary to overcome obstacles and unlock parts of the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/cf8f82f07d1d303d048b59591e04f529be62d3cb.gif[/img]

[b]Final tips[/b]
Some weapons have a chance of dealing critical damage, dealing massive amounts of damage if you are lucky. You can throw all your weapons except for the hammer. But the hammer has a special area damage attack, if you have unlocked this skill. All enemies carrying a weapon will drop it after you defeat it.

That’s pretty much it! Get ready to wield that pig war hammer and save the Netherworld!

notes.title: The World Of Leif's Adventure.
notes.notes:
[h1]Hammerfall[/h1]

The world of Leif's Adventure offers a variety of characters, stories, and myths.

[previewyoutube=72VrSzw9YN8;full][/previewyoutube]

Our tale begins in the tranquil northern village of [b]Hammerfall[/b]. Leif has lived there for as long as he can remember with his brother [b]Ragnar [/b]and his father [b]Thorsen[/b]. 

Leif's mother died shortly after he was born, so he has no memory of her at all. The other inhabitants of Hammerfall are known for their rough-hewnness but also for their cordiality. They like to have parties in the local tavern, which can sometimes end in a brawl. But the next day at the latest, all the dust settles. If need be, Thorsen, as the head of the village, will take care that the disputes are put aside. After all, the villagers have to stick together in the harsh northern world.

[h2]Leif[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/36df6f81b99379cac76b346a1731ed3457028ebd.jpg[/img]

[h2]Ragnar[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/d8a9d6ae0572fb88880d665b67438744460d1866.jpg[/img]

[h2]Thorsen[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/9516ff01eb593bdb5e26f2059d825d23b508a474.jpg[/img]

Besides taking care of their own people, the monthly dragon ritual is one of the most important events in [b]Hammerfall[/b]. Every villager donates a little something to the great sky dragons, which, according to legend, fight against each other in an endless battle in the firmament. In doing so, they symbolize good and evil, day and night, and light and darkness. These gifts are brought by Ragnar to Mount Dragon's Tooth and offered there in a temple to the dragon gods. 

[previewyoutube=SZs1530-kyE;full][previewyoutube=YWlcnhcFVn4;full][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

Since last winter, when the village barely had enough to survive, Ragnar is beginning to question this ritual a little and wonders whether it makes sense to throw resources into the dragon's maw month after month. He looks for better use and a tragedy is unleashed.

notes.title: 2021 - an honest review of the year by a game developer
notes.notes:
[h1]2021 - A Review![/h1]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/ac8814c8f9f384d4c3fe065d9fc628e7478e1451.jpg[/img]
[h2]A long time ago![/h2]
When you're tackling a big project, such as writing a book, making a film, or, as in my case, developing a game, you can get overwhelmed by the complexity. This is especially the case in the field of computer games because you have to combine many disciplines such as graphics, music, programming, storytelling, and so on. I started with the project Leif's Adventure over six years ago. An unimaginably long time, in which I have to concentrate and motivate myself every day. In the first years, it was still very easy. The motivation was high and I didn't have to provide additional income because I had savings that I could invest. After that, the complexity increased year by year. 
Besides the development, I had to take care of work assignments to cover my personal and the costs of the project. I do not want to go into too much detail here, because it is primarily about the last year, the year 2021. 


[h2]When will Leif's Adventure be ready?[/h2]
I was asked at the beginning of the year when Leif's Adventure will finally be finished. Whereby the "finally" was mentally inserted by me, then I was pretty sure that it will happen this year. But there were further postponements and sometime in the middle of the year, it was clear to me that I would not be able to keep the start date again and that I would have to postpone it to the next year.
This led to a lot of frustration, which became even bigger from month to month, as it became more foreseeable that it probably won't even be for a start in the beginning, but rather in the middle of the year 2022. So now I sit in the office between the years and ask myself: What was actually achieved this year? Was it a year of failure or do I just have to look closely to discover how much was actually achieved? And that's exactly what I want to do in this annual review.

I spent this morning reading through the commit logs and listing the major accomplishments. I was able to list [b]159 completed processes[/b]. These are by far not all, but only the elements that I  thought worth mentioning. 

For example, things like the following:
[list]
[*]New quests
[*]New outfits
[*]New features f. e. the new save system
[*]New characters
[*]Bugfixes
[*]New sound effects and music
[*] New levels
[*] And much more...
[/list]

-----------------------------------------------

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/ccd42eca39a0d94db88be6d2c63d564c330dbe69.jpg[/img]
[h2]The Highlights[/h2]
To make the whole thing a bit more exciting I will create a few rankings. Let's go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/8642d491f34f82313a424c91c17eabecbefdd0b1.jpg[/img]
[h2]The 3 most complex features[/h2]

[h3]3. Added Keyboard controls for the PC[/h3]
The game should finally be playable with the keyboard. That was finally achieved this year.

[h3]2. Rework of the Options Menu[/h3]
The options menu has been completely reworked so that the language can now also be changed and the music or sound effects can be adjusted in their volume. 

[h3]1. The Savesystem[/h3]
The save system was finalized and then rebuilt so that the save logic is more consistent. Everything that you have gained until the next save point is now lost if you were not at a save point again. This now applies to everything and not as before, partly so partly different. Especially for the Nintendo Switch, this was a big challenge because the save process had to be outsourced to an extra thread so that the save process doesn't interrupt the game.

-----------------------------------------------


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/6b8b063cf5e80dab833e2b40529ac46854c58cbf.jpg[/img]
[h2]The 3 biggest chunks[/h2]
[h3]3. The Intro[/h3]
The intro of the game has been in planning for years and had some big difficulties with the singer and composer of the intro song because his motivation has decreased more and more until the contact was unfortunately completely broken off at some point. So I was even happier when I found a new composer and singer. The two of them delivered a great song. My wife and I rewrote the lyrics. In August, I also implemented the animations and camera movements in Unity. The result is something to see and hear. See for yourself:

[previewyoutube=MsV2Rve3xb0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]2. The Demo 2.0 ![/h3]
For the Steam Next Festival, I wanted to publish a new demo. This should show more of the game and mechanisms that were not yet available in the old demo. Also, the new demo was now also playable with the keyboard
. 
If you haven't played the demo yet. You can try it here for free:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1392980/Leifs_Adventure_Netherworld_Hero/]Demo[/url]

[h3]1. Sulfite-Land - The last level[/h3]
When I first started developing the game, my estimate of the development time for a new level was about a month. At some point, I went to about 3 months. But now I know that the new complexity and the level of detail I'm aiming for now means that a development time of 4-6 months per level is more likely to be necessary. Exactly that was confirmed with the last level. But the sulfite land is also the most varied and of course the most difficult area of the game.

In the video here you can see a part of the development:
[previewyoutube=WFM1Wpk8TSU;full][/previewyoutube]

-----------------------------------------------


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/89f07ed2a2203b9e98dba15812bd915388f92e08.jpg[/img]
[h2]The 3 coolest new enemies[/h2]

[h3]3. The Slimer[/h3]
The Slimer is a classic slime blob opponent. He comes in the 3 element types fire, electricity, and ice. What's exciting is that he reproduces himself when you attack him with the wrong weapon types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/96b228838643f3300ff9d86a022ca3b7b33ffb67.png[/img]

[h3]2. The ancient Snake - Angur[/h3]
Angur also plays with the elements. As a serpent mage, he can create shields of the three main elements. Here, too, the right weapons are trumps!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/0NjCv7rQ/Angur-WALK.gif[/img]

[h3]1. The Shadow Soldier[/h3]
The shadow soldier hides a very special secret! However, I do not want to look at it here at all. He is the final boss of the sulfite country. He also has a very special protection strategy, which you can only master in cooperation with Ghost. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/J49y0JT0/darkling.gif[/img]

-----------------------------------------------


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/a9ba9a31310806a1e97df3007725b65ac0421b70.jpg[/img]
[h2]The 3 biggest disappointments[/h2]

[h3]3. The old intro song[/h3]
As briefly mentioned above, this year I was forced to end the collaboration with the singer and composer for the intro song. Since he was simply no longer available. I guess the change requests I had were just too much. The song was great, but in my opinion, you still have to be able to change certain things if it makes it fit the game better. Having to learn that the collaboration that had only started so well came to an abrupt end was a shame and kind of disappointing. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/7LBJxRj8/bard.jpg[/img]

[h3]2. Gamescom 21[/h3]
Gamescom was great and it was cool to have a booth in the Indie Arena Booth thanks to Gamecity Hamburg. However, visibility was very poor due to the countless games. Thus, only very few people got lost in the Indie Arena Booth as well as on the Steam page for my game. The advertising effect was accordingly disappointing. 

[h3]1. Delay of the release date[/h3]
This year I really wanted to bring Leif's Adventure to market. You have to remember that the longer the game is in development, the higher the development costs are. Nevertheless, I want to release a good game and that's why I had to postpone the release date again. Admitting that was not easy! However, I know that it was the only right decision. Still, it is the biggest disappointment of 2021.

-----------------------------------------------


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/31d847b772d2275ddfd1faa89d98b9dd0728bf4e.jpg[/img]
[h2]The 3 best social media happenings[/h2]

[h3]3. Twitter[/h3]
Twitter is a great platform to connect with gamers, but especially with other developers. 2021 was a good year on Twitter. The channel gained over 250 new followers and the strongest tweet had over 17,000 impressions.

[url=https://twitter.com/OneManOnMars/status/1422520874566098955]Best Tweet of the Year![/url]

[h3]2. Best Indie Game of April[/h3]
In April, I noticed a sharp increase in wishlist entries. It had taken me a while to figure out where that came from. So, I was even more pleased when I saw that Leif's Adventure was listed in the trailer for the best indie games of April 2021. Thank you Clemmy!

See for yourself:
[previewyoutube=O6OJWcJ6YNk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]1. Steam Next Fest Live Stream[/h3]
It was a great success that Leif's Adventure was accepted for Steam Next Fest this summer. It was even featured in the adventure trailer here. 
[previewyoutube=eX4zBUZsvno;full][/previewyoutube]

But my personal highlight was the live stream I did together with my wife on a blisteringly warm summer evening. We had an average of over 600 viewers at the same time and almost 1000 viewers at the maximum. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/cLrV9tZR/stream.jpg[/img]

There are still so many things I would like to list here, such as the new logo. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/3dfbddc0afc50156a1334a92a5f11fa49a28229e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38615494/8b7277d0b28eab01405e20ed28e248aec773cb7b.png[/img][/url]

But I would like to close with a thank you. A thank you to everyone who continues to believe in the project and who supports me on this long journey. 
If you already added Leif's Adventure to your Steam Wishlist, follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/OneManOnMars]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/onemanonmars/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/gaming/OneManOnMarsAG]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCiavhY1jBW9A2tPgndT0YWA/videos]Youtube [/url]or subscribe to the [url=https://www.leifsadventure.com]newsletter[/url], then you are one of them too! 

Thanks a lot and happy new year!

This month was all about creating the boss fight for the sulfite ground. Creating a boss enemy is always a fun process but also a bit taxing. The goal is to create a specific gameplay element that is different for each boss. As important is to use both characters' capabilities. Leif nor Ghost should be bored during the fight. Similar to the level I start with some rough ideas. Thereafter I block out the elements that are now to this boss enemy. To see if the ideas do work as planned. If this is successful the next step is to add the other attacks and movements. To see if all movements work together. During the whole process, a lot of playtesting is needed. I also make sure the art assets and animations do look good. And in the end, we hopefully have an engaging and challenging boss fight.


[h2]Cutscenes - The story needs to be told.[/h2]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/cCQ13f7K/CS.png[/img]

Since this boss is the last level boss, the story of course also slowly comes to a head. Therefore, cutscenes are needed that properly set the scene for the individual characters and advance the story. For this, I have made a few streams on Twitch and Steam in the last few days. The streams will be available for a few days. But maybe I'll make a Youtube video out of it later in a shorter form.

notes.title: Hello Ghost, my friend.
notes.notes:
Leif’s Adventure Netherworld Hero features a unique two-character system. Our hero Leif is supported by the supernatural and super-cute sidekick Ghost. In the single-player mode, you can switch between two characters at the push of a button. Or you share the fun with a friend in coop mode and each of you plays one of the characters.

The two protagonists have totally different abilities and gameplay styles. While Leif is a traditional action-adventure hero Ghost has some unique tricks up his imaginary sleeves. And only as a team, the two can succeed.

[b]In this article Ghost is the star so let’s have a closer look at his specific skills.
[/b]
Let’s start with the obvious first. Ghost can fly. This means he can reach areas where Leif can’t go on his own. But since the two characters can’t strive too far away from each other Ghost should make sure that his friend will be able to follow by activating or moving around specific platforms.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/9MYpdXdW/2characterexamples-broken-Cave.gif[/img]

But there are other ways our ghostly friend can shine. There are many other specific objects in the environment that Ghost can interact with. For example, slow down hazards, activate flowers to give Leif a boost when floating, activate switches to open doors, collect hard to reach loot, or activate hints in the environment. There is much more for Ghost to do so just give it a try. Important to note: If something is glowing blueish the chances are high that Ghost can interact with it.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/qRNmTHy0/Use-Switchwith-Ghost.gif[/img]

Ghost seems small but he is surprisingly wreckless maybe because he can’t take any damage. So be fearless when playing with him as well and use his abilities to explore every nook and cranny in the fantastic worlds you will wander around in.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/9QpV4ZS0/Foxguide-zoom.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/v8WKHMCH/Ghost-slows-down-wheel.gif[/img]

But Ghost has also his week spots. He is not the biggest fighter. But this does not mean that he is useless when Leif swings his weapons. Ghost can stun enemies to give Leif the upper hand in a tight fight, drop stalactites on bigger-than-life monsters, or distract enemies so Leif can sneak up from behind. And if you’re very creative you can use Ghost to lure enemies into vicious traps. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/6QrH6f1b/Lure-Enemies-with-Ghost.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/hj8NwBBj/stun-feature.gif[/img]

And we should not forget about the phantoms! Leif can't even hurt them before Ghost demasks and drags them into this dimension.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/bwHYQKGz/monophantom-attack.gif[/img]


There you have it. Ghost is not a simple sidekick he is an integral part of this unlikely duo and only together they can overcome all the challenges this big adventure throws at them. 

You can play the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1392980/Leifs_Adventure_Netherworld_Hero/]demo [/url]today in single-player or coop mode! And don't forget to put it on your wishlist!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/qv9zqKZ9/Friendship1.gif[/img]

notes.title: A closer look at Leif's Adventures weapon and armor system.
notes.notes:
In this article, I walk you through the gameplay features and give you an exclusive insight into the battle system, weapons, and armor and what Leif will encounter on his quest through the worlds of the Netherworld.

[previewyoutube=lDQixS-Yicg;full][/previewyoutube]

Leif’s Adventure is inspired by Nintendo titles such as The Legend of Zelda which have been a great influence on my career. The world is a homage to the great games I grew up with mixed with unexpected, unique features. So, let’s take a closer look.

[h2]The World[/h2]
The world of Leif's Adventure is connected by the roots of the World Tree. There are six worlds with Ariiobora at its center for you to explore.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/JhmsjWRq/spear-attack.gif[/img]

From Hammerfall the snowy mountains of Leif’s village to Broken Cave, a world full of crawling monsters in depth below ground, to the desert lands in Sandfalls. Each world will challenge you differently and you must put your skills to the test.

Need a break from the fighting? Return to Arribora, buy new potions, equip yourself with protective armor and new weapons, or just wander around and explore the unique world of Ariiobora.

[h2]Weapons[/h2]
Speaking of equipment: There are over 50 unique weapons. From an axe, longsword to battle speers. Each weapon brings a unique advantage. Defeat an enemy and pick up their weapon. But choose wisely.

[h2]Damage System[/h2]
When you equip your hero with a weapon you should think about its damage value, its durability, and the type of damage the weapon deals. A weapon should deal as much damage as possible. But what is it worth if the weapon is extremely slow or breaks after just a few hits? So, there are many things to consider.

[h2]The power of the elements[/h2]
The damage system in Life’s Adventure is based on the Rock, Paper, Scissor principle. The three elements are [b]FIRE[/b], [b]ICE[/b], and [b]ELECTRICITY[/b].

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/59qbFF6Z/elementary-damage-circle.jpg[/img]

Fire stops ice, ice beats electricity and electricity is stronger than fire.

Always consider the elementary effect a weapon can have. Because this effect can make your weapon extremely effective against certain types of enemies, but on the other hand can be less effective in other cases. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/rmGsmnBH/element-barrier.gif[/img]

The final attribute to consider is the attack speed. Weapons come in three main types. One-handed two-handed weapons and spears. The two-handed weapons are generally slower. But each weapon has its own speed attribute. So, make sure to test every weapon that you can get your hands on. On top of this, each main type has its own air attack. Two-handed weapons can to a powerbomb one-handed weapons are extremely effective against flying enemies since you can wield them while jumping.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L6Dyfmk9/airattack-GIF.gif[/img]

It is up to you to equip your weapon loadout in a way that lets you deal with all the challenges that you will face.

﻿
[h2]Inventory[/h2]
Your inventory has a limited storage capacity. There are different ways to earn inventory expansions. These are extremely valuable because they give you the possibility to take more items with you. More weapon types or extras health potions to heal your battle wounds.

[h2]Armor[/h2]
Speaking of battle wounds. Best to avoid them altogether and you can do that with the right armor. Gear up and change your wardrobe for better protection. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/VvDjSLx2/armor-Change.gif[/img]

Just like weapons, armor sets also have different qualities. They can strengthen your defense and influence your attack speed. But watch out for the elemental influence. For example, strong fire protection might be a problem against electro enemies.

Leif's Adventure: Netherworld Hero will be released later this year on Nintendo Switch and Steam, but you can already try the features for yourself in the free demo on Steam:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1392980/Leifs_Adventure_Netherworld_Hero/]Play the demo[/url]

Don't forget to put it on your wishilist+

notes.title: An unlikely hero!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/432x5sxX/lanh-mother-darkness-on-the-horizon-1024x564.png[/img]

In his dreams, Leif relives his mother’s tragic death. His mother passed away giving birth to him. The guilt and longing for a mother he never knew overshadow his dreams. Each night he fights to save her, only to wake up and to realize that no matter what, he will never be able to change the past.


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/kXNMHxg1/LANH-Father-adventurer-1024x562.png[/img]


Leif’s father too is haunted by the past. The death of his wife turned him into an overprotective father. He is scared to lose Leif and will do everything to keep him out of harm’s way.

A father struck with grief and an older brother, Ragnar, the seasoned warrior that everyone looks up to. Leif feels small in the shadow of his family. Will he ever be as brave as his brother? He looks up to him and dreams of becoming a strong warrior like his brother, that protects the village and is trusted by everyone. Ragnar is held in such high esteem that he was chosen to undertake the monthly dragon ritual.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/25yz3MFM/village.gif[/img]


Leif’s village honors the belief that two dragons fight an eternal battle in the sky. The dragon serving the light and the dragon creating the darkness. This battle has been going on since the beginning of time.

The villagers believe that they must bring the dragon of light offerings each month so that he remains strong and defeats the dragon of darkness. The ritual is key in keeping the balance between light and darkness.

Leif’s brother was chosen to bring the offerings to the Dragon’s horn at the top of the mountain so that the dragon of light can feast and replenish, thus gaining strength for a new cycle of battles.

Leif dreams of becoming an admired warrior like his brother. But Leif's father thinks differently. Leif’s future is set in stone. He is destined to be the blacksmith's assistance.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/5N2kcJxh/Leifs-Adventure-Forge-1024x512.jpg[/img]

Fire and steal instead of the cold blade in battle. Forging the blades for the warriors instead of becoming one himself.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/B6CNyYRZ/Leif-Smith.gif[/img]

At night Leif sneaks into the village tavern to listen to songs of heroes’ past and dreams about becoming one himself. He dreams that one day they will sing a song about his epic battles.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/1zhHz1Q5/7xkt-CFu-Q-1024x576.jpg[/img]

But someone is never seen of late at the tavern. Leif’s brother Ragnar is keeping watch at night. Something is keeping him up and he gazes upon the darkness weary of an evil force. Leif tries to understand what is going on with his brother. His brother is keeping a secret from him. But what could it be? He will find out soon enough.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/J0k00vmM/ragnar-On-Tower.gif[/img]

On the morning of the ritual things are unraveling fast. Leif's village is attacked by Phantom Warriors. No mortal blade can harm these evil forces from another dimension. Only the dragon sword Ragnar carries can defeat them. Leif's father wants to protect Leif. He doesn't think Leif to be strong enough to fight in the battle. Instead, he is sent away to find his brother.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/RVtXfLT0/village-attack.gif[/img]

Leif runs as fast as his legs can carry him to the top of the mountain where he believes the ritual to be taking place. But things have taken a different turn of events. For there is no dragon, but a great evil awaiting Leif.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/dVsJNY9k/kill-Ragnaron-Mtn-Top.gif[/img]

Leif arrives too late. In horror, he watches as his brother is fatally wounded by an evil foe and thrown into a magical portal. Little does Leif know that the evil force he witnessed has been the cause of the danger brought upon his village. Minjaar is the master of the Phantom Warriors and the darkness lurking in the shadow of his dreams.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/QCTkQj1z/lanh-minjaar-1024x560.jpg[/img]

Now it is upon Leif to save his brother and his village. Leif has no choice but to jump after his brother through the portal. And so his quest to the Netherworld begins. The quest to save his brother, village, and most importantly learn the true meaning of being a hero.

Join him when the game is ready later this year! [b]Put it on your wishlist now![/b]

notes.title: A new level is born!
notes.notes:
[h1]GAME DEVELOPMENT PROGRESS![/h1]

[h2]A new level is born[/h2]
Leif’s Adventure combines six big worlds into a single, exciting adventure. Creating these worlds and filling them with challenging puzzles, fights, and riddles is a lot of work. But Leif's Adventure is coming along nicely.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/8Btx6Xd/level-construction.gif[/img]

A level is created out of several layers. In the gif above you can first see the ground structure of the level. In the next step, the background and the filler or wall elements are added. The next is integrating dynamic lights to give the environment an interesting look.
As the last step, I love to add a lot of decoration to tell a story.
In the Sandfall level, we visit a fallen tiger kingdom that has been destroyed by an evil witch and is recovering slowly.

[h2]Breathing life into the level[/h2]
But a level would be nothing without inhabitants and maybe even more important foes to fight. For the Sandfall level, I have created the Tigros. This old tiger-tribe has been fighting against the crazy witch Kara for the last 10 years and have finally managed to get her behind bars.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/6B00Qh4/tiger-animation.gif[/img]


[h2]The foes in Sandfall[/h2]
Next to Kara, there are many bigger and smaller foes waiting for you. Somewhere hidden in the catacombs of Sandfall awaits Angur the snake god!
He is a master of the elements and will challenge you with magical elemental defense and attack tricks!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/T0mJbPQ/Angur-WALK.gif[/img]

Minjaar will also ramp up the forces he sends against you. In Sandfall you will face a new phantom warrior type! A very big one:

[img]https://i.ibb.co/jgRDnGm/monophan.gif[/img]

Make sure you work as a team and combine the abilities of both characters to fight your way through the level.


[h2]Bosstime[/h2]
Every good level needs a final challenge. In Sandfall you will face off against the evil witch Kara in an epic airship battle. You can control the ship with Leif and fire the canon with Ghost. Together you can win this fight.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/nzGGSJ1/airshipbattle.gif[/img]

[h3] Make sure to put Leif's Adventure on your wishlist to support me![/h3]
